run_collision_filter_demo: run the pybullet collision filter demo that loads a plane and cube with collision filtering
create_collision_filter_group_mask: create a pybullet scene that sets collision filter group and mask on a loaded URDF body
enable_collision_filter_pair: enable or disable collision between two specific bodies using setCollisionFilterPair in pybullet
load_urdf_with_maximal_coordinates: load a URDF model into pybullet with useMaximalCoordinates set to False
set_realtime_simulation_gravity: set real-time simulation mode and configure gravity in a pybullet physics environment
